oncall.title: Need more personal preparation?
oncall.text: Individual telc B1 lessons are available on request and can focus on your exam date, your current level and the sections you find most difficult.

items.q: Is this course right for me?
items.a: It is right for you if you plan to take the telc B1 exam and want to know exactly what happens in every part of it. It is exam preparation, not a full A2 to B1 language course.

items.q: Do I already need to be at B1 level?
items.a: You should already be close to B1. The course prepares you for the exam format and tasks, it does not teach the level from the beginning.

items.q: Is the official telc exam included?
items.a: No. Registration and the exam fee are arranged separately with your exam centre.

items.q: Which parts of the exam will we practise?
items.a: All of them: reading and language elements, listening, writing, and speaking.
Yes. You get feedback on your writing tasks and on your speaking practice during the course.

items.q: Will we complete a mock exam?
items.a: Yes. The course ends with a realistic simulation under exam conditions.

items.q: Can you guarantee that I will pass?
items.a: No. No course can guarantee a result. What the course does is make sure you know the format, the scoring and the tasks before exam day.
Yes, on request. They can focus on your exam date, your level and the sections you find most difficult.

final.title: Your exam date is fixed. Your preparation should be too.
final.text: Join the next four-week course and walk into your telc B1 exam knowing what to do.
